mapper.insert: insert into project_invite (project_id, invitee_user_id, status, inviter_by, create_by, update_by) values (#{projectId}, #{inviteeUserId}, 'PENDING', #{inviterBy}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select invite_id, project_id, invitee_user_id, status, inviter_by, invite_time, handle_by, handle_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted from project_invite where project_id = #{projectId} and invitee_user_id = #{inviteeUserId} and deleted = 0 limit 1

select invite_id, project_id, invitee_user_id, status, inviter_by, invite_time, handle_by, handle_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted from project_invite where invite_id = #{inviteId}
mapper.update: update project_invite set status = #{status}, handle_by = #{handleBy}, handle_time = #{handleTime}, update_by = #{updateBy} where invite_id = #{inviteId} and deleted = 0
update project_invite set deleted = 1 where invite_id = #{inviteId}
